Name: Content Patcher - Primitive Artisan Equipment
Author: tlitookilakin
Description:
A version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/940]Ankokou's Primitive Artisan Equipment[/url], updated for Content Patcher by Swyrl AKA Tlitookilakin. All art is solely the work of Ankokou. I have [url=https://imgur.com/uCL8HKm]Ankokou's permission[/url] to upload this and continue updating it, however, all issues should be reported here rather than the original thread.

Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI, obviously.

Install Instructions:
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher
Extract the zip, and place the folder inside it in your Stardew "Mods" folder.

Configs are here, my next update plan will include some original artwork in the same style for unskinned/newer craftables.

Downloads.Description: Improved config legibility and added alternate "classic" art option for the oil press, also created by ankokou. (other options are "default" and "disabled".)

Manifest.Name: Primitive Artisan Equipment
Manifest.Description: Turns your artisan equipment from machines into more primitive looking crafting stations.
